stories.title: "New cat alert!": the first new cat species in over 100 years
stories.summary: National Geographic announced that a wildlife sanctuary's call about a "weird cat" led to the first new cat species discovered in over 100 years, found in Bolivia's Yungas forest. The post got 379K likes, and quotes like "NEW CAT DROPPED I REPEAT NEW CAT DROPPED" added more than 700K.
